CLINICAL DOCUMENTATION — NARRATIVE SPECIALTY CONSULT NOTE V1
Patient: William Jackson | MRN: PAT-60016 | DOB: 1953-06-22 | Gender: Male | Doc ID: NARRATIVE_0016
Encounter Date: 2025-06-01 | Discharge/Note Date: 2025-06-03 | Provider: Dr. Robert Evans, MD
REASON FOR CONSULTATION
Consult requested by primary medical team regarding refractory clinical optimization and therapeutic titration. Consultant
team: Cardiovascular Medicine Consult Service.
CHRONOLOGICAL CLINICAL NARRATIVE
CHRONOLOGICAL CLINICAL NARRATIVE: We were asked to evaluate patient William Jackson, who was admitted three
days ago with complex multisystem decompensation. On initial presentation, initial biomarker profiling revealed hemoglobin
of 9.82 g/dL (LOW). Subsequent evaluation demonstrated that serum sodium was 149.2 mmol/L (HIGH). Prior outpatient
regimens had proven insufficient to achieve therapeutic stability.
HOSPITAL COURSE & TRAJECTORY
HOSPITAL COURSE & TRAJECTORY: During inpatient specialty evaluation, the consultant team adjusted pharmacological
therapy. The patient was initiated on Metformin 850 mg oral twice daily. Following this intervention, trajectory assessment
showed platelet count of 520.9 10*3/uL (HIGH). Clinical response has been favorable with marked improvement in objective
metabolic parameters.
FOCUSED PHARMACOTHERAPY RECOMMENDATIONS
FOCUSED PHARMACOTHERAPY RECOMMENDATIONS: The specialty team recommends the following maintenance
regimen: continue Metoprolol 25 mg PO twice daily; and titrate Omeprazole 20 mg PO once daily in the morning. Avoid
NSAIDs and nephrotoxic exposures.
CONSULTANT ASSESSMENT & SPECIALTY PLAN
The patient is stabilized and appropriate for transfer to the regular step-down floor. Re-evaluate laboratory markers in 48
hours. Thank you for this interesting consultation.
